title: Baroque & the Dramatic Light
description: The drama, movement, and shadow-pierced chiaroscuro of 17th-century Europe.
source: Art Institute of Chicago, Cleveland Museum of Art, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Wikimedia Commons

items.title: The Calling of Saint Matthew
items.description_narrative: Men gathered around a table counting coins barely notice the shaft of light and the pointing hand that cuts across the dim tavern, two robed figures standing just inside the doorway. Caravaggio painted this Calling of Saint Matthew for the Contarelli Chapel of San Luigi dei Francesi, where it remains.
items.tags: caravaggio, calling of matthew, tenebrism, contarelli chapel, tavern scene

items.title: The Supper at Emmaus
items.description_narrative: One disciple throws his arms wide in astonishment while the other grips the table, both recognizing the stranger who has just blessed the bread beside them. A basket of fruit teeters at the table's edge, and an innkeeper looks on without understanding what the others have just seen.
items.tags: supper at emmaus, religious art, chiaroscuro, baroque, caravaggio, biblical narrative, italian

items.title: The Conversion of Saint Paul on the Way to Damascus
items.description_narrative: A fallen man in armor lies flat on his back, arms flung wide, beneath a huge horse led carefully forward by an old groom who nearly fills the rest of the canvas. Caravaggio painted this Conversion around 1600–1601; it remains in the Cerasi Chapel of Santa Maria del Popolo.
items.tags: caravaggio, conversion of paul, horse, italian baroque, tenebrism
items.credit_line: Web Gallery of Art: Image Info about artworkwga QS:P11807,"c/caravagg/05/29ceras"

items.title: Bacchus
items.description_narrative: A flushed young man crowned with grape leaves reclines against white drapery, offering a shallow glass of dark wine toward the viewer beside a basket piled with fruit. Caravaggio painted this Bacchus; it hangs in the Uffizi Gallery.
items.tags: bacchus, caravaggio, mythology, wine, still life

items.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes
items.description_narrative: Judith grips a man's hair with a grimace of concentrated effort as her sword saws through his neck, blood spraying in thin red streams across the sheets. An old woman crouches beside her, holding out a cloth sack to receive the head.
items.tags: biblical, beheading, tenebrism, caravaggio

items.title: David with the Head of Goliath
items.description_narrative: A young man in a loose white shirt holds a bearded severed head at arm's length by its hair, a sword resting in his other hand. Caravaggio painted this David with the Head of Goliath; it hangs in the Galleria Borghese.
items.tags: caravaggio, david and goliath, severed head, italian baroque, sword

items.title: Boy with a Basket of Fruit
items.description_narrative: A youth with one bare shoulder holds a woven basket overflowing with grapes, figs, and pears against a plain wall, his gaze turned toward the viewer. Caravaggio painted this portrait around the 1590s; it hangs in the Galleria Borghese.
items.tags: caravaggio, fruit basket, portrait, still life, italian baroque

items.title: The Cardsharps
items.description_narrative: One young man studies his cards innocently while an older man in fingerless gloves signals across his shoulder to a second youth, who hides a card tucked into his belt behind his back. Caravaggio painted this scene around the 1590s; it hangs in the Kimbell Art Museum.
items.tags: caravaggio, card game, cardsharps, genre painting, italian baroque
items.credit_line: nAFtN9HI0FxbaQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Self-Portrait as the Allegory of Painting
items.description_narrative: Artemisia Gentileschi paints herself mid-motion, brush raised and arm outstretched toward an unseen canvas, sleeves rolled and hair falling loose from its pins. She cast herself as the personification of Painting itself rather than posing still for a conventional portrait.
items.tags: self-portrait, allegory, female artist, baroque, italian, artemisia gentileschi, painting

items.title: The Garden of Love
items.description_narrative: Couples gather beneath a grand stone loggia and beside a fountain crowned by a nude statue, cherubs darting between them as one woman is drawn gently into the crowd by her companion. Fashionable silks and dark furs mingle in a scene of courtly ease.
items.tags: garden party, courtly life, cherubs, fountain, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Samson and Delilah
items.description_narrative: Firelight falls across the bare back of Samson, asleep in the lap of Delilah, while a man behind them already cuts his hair and an old woman leans in with a candle. Through a doorway, armed soldiers wait in the dark for the signal to seize him.
items.tags: samson, delilah, betrayal, biblical narrative, flemish baroque, chiaroscuro, rubens

items.title: The Three Graces
items.description_narrative: Three nude women stand in a loose circle beneath a swag of roses, arms draped over one another's shoulders in an easy, unposed embrace. Rubens paints their flesh in warm, soft tones that catch the light differently across each figure, with a garden fountain and grazing deer behind them.
items.tags: three graces, mythological painting, nude, flemish baroque, rubens, allegory, classical
items.credit_line: The Prado in Google Earth: Home page 7th level of zoom, JPEG compression quality: Photoshop 10.

items.title: The Surrender of Breda
items.description_narrative: A defeated commander bows forward to hand over a large key while his victorious counterpart rests a hand gently on his shoulder, more courtesy than conquest. Velázquez lines up a forest of upright lances on the right against open, smoke-hazed plains behind the two men.
items.tags: surrender of breda, history painting, military history, spanish golden age, baroque, velazquez, portraiture

items.title: The Toilet of Venus (Rokeby Venus)
items.description_narrative: Venus lies with her back to the viewer, her reflection caught faintly in a mirror held up by a winged Cupid, dark drapery pooling beneath her against a vivid red curtain. Velázquez paints the whole figure in cool, silvery flesh tones against that single band of warm color.
items.tags: venus, nude, mythological painting, spanish golden age, baroque, velazquez, mirror
items.credit_line: Key facts. The National Gallery, London. Retrieved on 25 June 2013.

items.title: Old Woman Frying Eggs
items.description_narrative: An old woman spoons two eggs whitening in oil under a single shaft of light, her focus total. Beside her a boy holds a wine flask and a round melon, while a mortar, a jug, and a knife balanced on a plate crowd the table below.
items.tags: bodegon, kitchen scene, old woman, still life, chiaroscuro, spanish baroque, genre painting
items.credit_line: Google Art Project: Home - pic Maximum resolution.

items.title: The Storm on the Sea of Galilee
items.description_narrative: A small fishing boat pitches almost vertically as a wave crashes over its bow, sailors hauling desperately on the rigging while huddled figures cling together below deck. Light breaks through a gap in the black clouds, picking out the mast and sail against the dark water.
items.tags: storm, seascape, biblical narrative, dutch golden age, baroque, rembrandt, shipwreck

items.title: The Penitent Magdalen
items.description_narrative: A woman in profile sits in near-total darkness, her hands resting on a skull in her lap while two candle flames glow beside a gilded mirror. Painted by Georges de La Tour around 1640, the candlelit scene shows Mary Magdalene meditating on mortality. The painting is held by the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
items.tags: baroque, tenebrism, mary magdalene, chiaroscuro, religious art, candlelight
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.title: Saint Francis in Meditation
items.description_narrative: Hooded and kneeling in near-total darkness, Francis of Assisi cradles a skull in both hands, his lips parted as if mid-prayer. Only a narrow shaft of light picks out his face and the rope cinched at his waist.
items.tags: saint francis, meditation, skull, chiaroscuro, spanish baroque, monastic habit

items.title: Et in Arcadia ego (Les Bergers d'Arcadie)
items.description_narrative: Three shepherds and a woman gather in a wooded clearing around a stone tomb, one crouching to trace its carved inscription. Nicolas Poussin painted this version of Et in Arcadia ego around 1638.
items.tags: poussin, baroque, memento mori, pastoral, classical, landscape, allegory

items.title: Seaport with the Embarkation of the Queen of Sheba
items.description_narrative: Sunrise breaks directly over the water between two rows of grand classical buildings, tall-masted ships waiting at anchor while figures load boats and climb harbor steps. Claude Lorrain builds the whole scene as an invented, idealized port rather than any real place.
items.tags: seaport, classical landscape, ships, biblical narrative, baroque, claude lorrain, atmospheric light
items.credit_line: Web Gallery of Art: Image Info about artworkwga QS:P11807,"c/claude/2/10sheba"

items.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Philip
items.description_narrative: A bound, half-naked man is hoisted aloft on a wooden frame, his executioners straining at ropes above him, while onlookers gather at right and a woman shields a child at left. Ribera painted this large martyrdom scene in 1639.
items.tags: martyrdom, crucifixion, violence, drama, spanish baroque, ribera

items.title: The Immaculate Conception
items.description_narrative: Bathed in radiant light, a young woman in white and deep blue drifts upward on a bank of clouds, hands pressed to her chest and eyes lifted skyward, as cherubs below scatter lilies and roses. The imagery follows a tradition Spanish painters developed to depict Mary's conception free of sin, adapting the Book of Revelation's vision of a woman clothed with the sun.
items.tags: immaculate conception, virgin mary, cherubs, spanish baroque, murillo
items.credit_line: Collection of Cleveland Museum of Art

items.title: Judith Slaying Holofernes
items.description_narrative: Two women pin a struggling man to the bed, one gripping his hair and driving a sword through his throat while the other bears down with her full weight on his arm. Blood arcs across the white sheets in a scene of visceral, close physical force.
items.tags: biblical, beheading, violence, italian baroque, gentileschi

items.title: The Descent from the Cross
items.description_narrative: The triptych's outer wings show quieter moments, one figure gathering fruit, another presenting a child, while the center panel holds the most intense drama: men on ladders lower a pale, limp body wrapped in white cloth into grieving arms below.
items.tags: triptych, crucifixion, mourning, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: 1. Web Gallery of Art: Image Info about artworkwga QS:P11807,"/r/rubens/11religi/07desce" 2. Lukas VZW Art in Flanders Imagebank

items.title: The Massacre of the Innocents
items.description_narrative: Soldiers wrench infants from their mothers' arms amid a chaos of straining limbs and classical ruins; one man swings a sword, another lifts a child overhead, while women wail and claw at their attackers. Rubens painted this brutal scene around 1611–1612.
items.tags: violence, massacre, biblical, dramatic, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Susanna and the Elders
items.description_narrative: Susanna recoils and raises both hands against two men leaning over the wall above her, their whispered conspiracy pressed close to her bare shoulders. Artemisia Gentileschi paints her discomfort as physical and immediate rather than as a passive nude on display.
items.tags: susanna and the elders, biblical narrative, baroque, chiaroscuro, artemisia gentileschi, italian, psychological drama
items.credit_line: Web Gallery of Art: Image Info about artworkwga QS:P11807,"g/gentiles/artemisi/susanna"

items.title: Esther before Ahasuerus
items.description_narrative: Esther, richly dressed and crowned, swoons into the arms of an attendant, her hand reaching toward a bearded, crowned king who leans in to take it. Franciszek Smuglewicz painted this oil-on-canvas scene of Esther before Ahasuerus in 1778.
items.tags: esther, ahasuerus, biblical, religious art, baroque, oil painting, court scene, crown

items.title: The Abduction of the Sabine Women
items.description_narrative: A robed ruler stands atop a platform overseeing a chaotic square where armed men seize women from the crowd, with children left on the ground. Poussin painted this history scene in the 1630s; it belongs to the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
items.tags: history painting, poussin, chaos, roman legend, baroque

items.title: Agnus Dei
items.description_narrative: A single lamb lies bound on a dark stone ledge, its legs tied together, with a faint halo traced above its head. Zurbarán painted this small Agnus Dei around 1635; it is held by the San Diego Museum of Art.
items.tags: agnus dei, lamb, zurbaran, spanish baroque, still life

items.title: The Holy Family with Saints Elizabeth and John the Baptist
items.description_narrative: A young boy tugs at a woolly lamb while a bearded man reaches to steady him, and a mother in red cradles two infants close, one reaching up to touch her face. An older woman looks on from the side, a basket of linens resting nearby.
items.tags: holy family, lamb, infants, religious art, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Salome with the Head of Saint John the Baptist
items.description_narrative: Salome lifts the severed head of John the Baptist onto a platter, her expression more weary than triumphant as an attendant grips the hair and a kneeling boy braces the tray. Guido Reni sets the horror in soft, glowing flesh tones against near-total darkness.
items.tags: salome, john the baptist, martyrdom, italian baroque, religious art, guido reni, tenebrism

items.title: Saint Romanus of Antioch and Saint Barulas
items.description_narrative: A robed martyr holds an open book inscribed with lettering, its embroidered orphreys stitched with small painted scenes, while a wide-eyed boy at his side lifts a strip of cloth in his praying hands. A pale halo of light glows behind the saint's head.
items.tags: saint romanus, martyrdom, religious art, zurbaran, spanish baroque, seville, oil on canvas

items.title: Landscape with Saint John on Patmos
items.description_narrative: An elderly, robed man sits writing amid tumbled classical ruins — a cracked obelisk, drum-stacked columns, a temple glimpsed across calm water — within a landscape far larger than he is. Nicolas Poussin completed the scene in 1640, casting it as a historical landscape with John of Patmos at its edge.
items.tags: landscape, classical ruins, religious art, baroque, serene, poussin

items.title: Saint Martin and the Beggar
items.description_narrative: A knight on a white horse turns to face a half-naked beggar at the roadside, pulling his cloak between them so it can be cut and shared. El Greco elongates both figures beneath a stormy sky, giving an act of charity the same weight as a coronation.
items.tags: saint martin, charity, religious art, mannerism, el greco, horse, spanish renaissance

items.title: Saint Francis Kneeling in Meditation
items.description_narrative: Francis kneels in a rocky grotto, one hand pressed to his chest as he gazes down at a small crucifix propped against a skull on a ledge. A scrap of paper lies discarded on the ground nearby, and ivy creeps into the frame at upper left.
items.tags: saint francis, crucifix, skull, grotto, meditation, spanish mannerism

items.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
items.description_narrative: Mary rises in vivid blue and crimson, arms outstretched among cherubs and a burst of golden light, while apostles below crowd around her empty tomb, pointing upward. El Greco painted this altarpiece in 1577–1579; it is held by the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: assumption, el greco, virgin mary, apostles, spanish renaissance
items.credit_line: 0wG7A7al0WzGWg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Crucifixion
items.description_narrative: A single crucified figure emerges from total blackness, his feet resting on a small wooden ledge and a lettered plaque fixed above his head. Zurbarán painted this Crucifixion in 1627; it is held by the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: crucifixion, zurbaran, spanish baroque, tenebrism, religious art

items.title: Cupid Chastised
items.description_narrative: A young man raises a knotted rope over a winged boy pinned beneath his knee, arrows and a helmet scattered on the ground, while a woman grips the boy's leg and a dove flies overhead. Manfredi painted this Cupid Chastised in 1613; it belongs to the Art Institute of Chicago.
items.tags: cupid chastised, manfredi, mythology, italian baroque, punishment

items.title: Don Gaspar de Guzmán (1587–1645), Count-Duke of Olivares
items.description_narrative: A nobleman in gleaming black armor and a crimson sash sits astride a rearing white horse, glancing back over his shoulder as smoke rises from a distant battle. This version is based on Velázquez's own equestrian portrait of the same sitter.
items.tags: equestrian portrait, nobleman, armor, spanish baroque
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: The Jabach Family
items.description_narrative: A seated man in a dark robe is surrounded by his wife and children, one daughter offering a small dog her hand while the youngest sits wrapped in orange cloth. Scholarly props, a globe, an open book, a gilded bust, even a skull, crowd the floor around them.
items.tags: family portrait, group portrait, still life props, french baroque, le brun
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Charity
items.description_narrative: A woman in a loose headscarf tends three infants at once, one sleeping in her lap, another reaching up over her shoulder, a third nursing at her side. This Charity was painted around 1630; it belongs to the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
items.tags: charity, allegory, mother and children, baroque, oil painting
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Self-Portrait
items.description_narrative: A long-haired man in dark robes, a wreath of leaves in his hair, bends over a human skull propped on a book and inscribes something on it with a quill. The candlelit contrast between his pale hands and the black background gives the whole scene a hushed, meditative weight.
items.tags: self-portrait, skull, memento mori, baroque, oil on canvas, italian, 17th century
items.credit_line: Collection of The Metropolitan Museum of Art

items.title: Christ in the House of Martha and Mary
items.description_narrative: A young cook grinds garlic with a mortar and pestle beside a plate of fish and eggs, an older woman gesturing at her shoulder, while a framed scene of a seated man and two women glows through an opening in the wall behind them. Velázquez painted this kitchen scene around 1618; it hangs in the National Gallery.
items.tags: velazquez, kitchen scene, martha and mary, bodegon, spanish baroque
items.credit_line: 1./2. picasaweb3. gallerix.ru4. National Gallery, London - online collection

items.title: The Immaculate Conception
items.description_narrative: Diego Velázquez painted this Immaculate Conception around 1616, showing the Virgin Mary standing on a pale sphere, hands clasped in prayer beneath a halo of stars. Billowing clouds surround her against a luminous sky, in a work now held by the Focus-Abengoa Foundation.
items.tags: baroque, religious art, oil painting, virgin mary, velázquez, spanish art

items.title: Tavern Scene with Two Men and a Girl (Peasants at the Table)
items.description_narrative: A servant girl pours dark red wine into a glass at the center of the table while two men lean in on either side, one gesturing mid-conversation with his thumb raised. Bread, a knife, a bowl of orange slices and a small onion are laid out on a plain white cloth, painted with the same close attention as the faces.
items.tags: tavern scene, bodegon, genre painting, still life, spanish baroque, velazquez, everyday life

items.title: Christ after the Flagellation Contemplated by the Christian Soul
items.description_narrative: Christ sits bound and bruised beside a whipping post strewn with rope and instruments of torment, as a winged angel gently guides a kneeling child's gaze toward him. Velázquez painted this scene around 1626; it hangs in the National Gallery.
items.tags: velazquez, christ, flagellation, angel, spanish baroque

items.title: The Needlewoman
items.description_narrative: A young woman bends over her sewing, absorbed, her red cap the single bright note against loosely brushed, sketch-like surroundings. Velázquez left the setting around her barely worked, focusing all attention on her hands and downturned face.
items.tags: sewing, portrait, genre scene, unfinished, spanish baroque, velazquez

items.title: Saint John the Evangelist on the Island of Patmos
items.description_narrative: Saint John pauses mid-sentence, quill raised over an open book, as a small vision of a robed figure appears in a burst of cloud at upper left. An eagle rests half-hidden in shadow beside him, and a distant landscape opens up through the rocks behind.
items.tags: saint john, patmos, vision, eagle, religious, spanish baroque, quill
items.credit_line: The Yorck Project (2002) 10.000 Meisterwerke der Malerei (DVD-ROM), distributed by DIRECTMEDIA Publishing GmbH. ISBN: 3936122202.

items.title: The Luncheon (El Almuerzo)
items.description_narrative: Three men crowd around a bare table set with mussels, bread, a cut pomegranate and a glass of wine; one raises a thumb, another tips a flask overhead, while a hood and ruffled collar hang on the wall behind them. Velázquez painted this early genre scene around 1617.
items.tags: bodegon, genre scene, tavern, still life, spanish baroque, velazquez

items.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
items.description_narrative: Saint Catherine kneels beside the spiked wheel of her intended torture, a sword and a martyr's palm resting at her feet. A faint halo and a steady, direct gaze mark her out amid otherwise plain, contemporary dress.
items.tags: saint catherine, martyrdom, spiked wheel, sword, halo, chiaroscuro, italian baroque

items.title: The Seven Works of Mercy
items.description_narrative: Caravaggio crowds a whole street's worth of charitable acts into one dark, vertical canvas: a man tears his cloak for a beggar, a woman nurses an old man through prison bars, a figure carries a torch past a body being buried. Overhead, two angels tumble down with a mother and child, blessing it all from within the same shadowed space.
items.tags: works of mercy, charity, tenebrism, baroque, religious art, caravaggio, naples

items.title: Martha and Mary Magdalene
items.description_narrative: Two women lean toward each other across a table — one in plain dress gesturing as she speaks, the other in a satin sleeve holding a small flower and resting a hand on a large convex mirror. Caravaggio painted the pair around 1598, reportedly using Fillide Melandroni as his model.
items.tags: two women, mirror, conversation, religious allegory, baroque, caravaggio

items.title: Amor Vincit Omnia (Cupid as Victor)
items.description_narrative: A grinning winged boy props one leg on a bundle of drapery, clutching arrows. Sheet music, a violin, and pieces of armor lie scattered and abandoned at his feet. Caravaggio painted this Cupid around 1601–1602; it belongs to the Gemäldegalerie Berlin.
items.tags: cupid, caravaggio, allegory, still life, italian baroque

items.title: Rest on the Flight into Egypt
items.description_narrative: An angel plays the violin from sheet music held open by a seated, bearded man, while a mother and sleeping infant rest against her shoulder nearby. A pack donkey grazes in the shadows behind them, and autumn-colored leaves frame a quiet river landscape beyond.
items.tags: holy family, angel musician, landscape, religious, italian baroque, tenebrism

items.title: The Sacrifice of Isaac
items.description_narrative: A knife hovers at a bound, half-clothed youth's throat as an angel grips a bearded old man's wrist just in time. A ram looks on beside a boy holding a hen, all lit in a tense wedge of light against total darkness.
items.tags: religious drama, abraham, isaac, angel, chiaroscuro, old testament, italian baroque

items.title: The Lute Player
items.description_narrative: A young musician with tousled curls and a ribbon in their hair leans over a lute, mid-note, beside an open score, a violin and bow, ripe fruit, and a vase of irises and marigolds. Caravaggio painted this Hermitage canvas around 1595.
items.tags: music, still life, flowers, baroque, caravaggio, chiaroscuro
items.credit_line: Hermitage Torrent (.torrent with info-hash) Hermitage Paintings Государственный Эрмитаж

items.title: Saint Francis of Assisi in Ecstasy
items.description_narrative: Francis of Assisi lies swooning in the dark of night, cradled by an angel who steadies his chest with one hand. Faint light glows on water in the background, the only brightness in an otherwise black landscape.
items.tags: saint francis, angel, ecstasy, night scene, chiaroscuro, italian baroque

items.title: Penitent Magdalene
items.description_narrative: Caravaggio painted this Penitent Magdalene around 1593, showing Mary Magdalene seated with head bowed and hands clasped in her lap, a pearl necklace and small vessel abandoned on the floor beside her. The canvas belongs to the Galleria Doria Pamphilj.
items.tags: baroque, caravaggio, religious art, mary magdalene, oil painting, tenebrism

items.title: The Fortune Teller (Louvre version)
items.description_narrative: A plumed young man offers his palm to a turbaned woman, her knowing smile masking the ring she quietly slides from his finger. This is Caravaggio's second telling of the same exchange, painted as a later version of his earlier Fortune Teller.
items.tags: fortune teller, deception, genre painting, caravaggio

items.title: Madonna of the Rosary
items.description_narrative: The Madonna and Child are raised above a crowd of kneeling, reaching figures beneath a heavy red curtain, while a white-robed friar hands out rosaries at left and a bearded man gestures toward the pair at right. Caravaggio completed this altarpiece in 1607, now in Vienna's Kunsthistorisches Museum.
items.tags: madonna, rosary, altarpiece, religious, baroque, caravaggio
items.credit_line: uwFbpzSFs7n4rg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Fortune Teller (Capitoline version)
items.description_narrative: A young man in a plumed hat extends his hand to a turbaned woman, who studies his palm with a faint, knowing smile while gently working a ring from his finger. Neither figure seems to notice the quiet theft taking place mid-conversation.
items.tags: fortune teller, deception, genre painting, caravaggio

items.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
items.description_narrative: An armored soldier looks on as two men press a crown of thorns onto a bowed head with wooden rods, a heavy red cloak draped across his shoulders. Caravaggio painted this scene around 1602–1604.
items.tags: caravaggio, crown of thorns, christ, passion, italian baroque
items.credit_line: yAGZLO5MaPVjfQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Portrait of a Gentleman (possibly Scipione Borghese)
items.description_narrative: A dark-eyed man with a trim mustache and beard turns slightly, his black cloak set against a bare wall. A crisp white collar, the sitter's brightest feature besides his face, catches most of the light.
items.tags: portrait, baroque, chiaroscuro, mustache, dark clothing, italian baroque
items.credit_line: HwFs76jOWISBWg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Narcissus
items.description_narrative: A young man kneels at the edge of dark water, bent so low his face nearly meets its mirrored double, the reflection glowing almost as brightly as he does against the surrounding black. Caravaggio painted this scene around 1597.
items.tags: mythology, reflection, water, narcissus, baroque, caravaggio

items.title: Boy Bitten by a Lizard
items.description_narrative: A boy recoils sharply, mouth open and hand snapping back, from a glass vase of flowers and fruit on the table before him. Caravaggio painted this scene around the 1590s; it hangs in the National Gallery.
items.tags: caravaggio, boy, lizard, still life, italian baroque

items.title: The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist
items.description_narrative: A hand grips the victim's hair, wrenching his head back as a streak of dark red spreads across the stone floor beneath him, faint marks visible within it. Caravaggio painted this Beheading in 1608; it hangs in St. John's Co-Cathedral.
items.tags: caravaggio, beheading, john the baptist, italian baroque, religious art
items.credit_line: Scanned from: Caravaggio, Rossella Vodret, Francesco Buranelli (eds.), Skira-Rizzoli, 2010. ISBN 978-88-572-0458-1

items.title: Death of the Virgin
items.description_narrative: A close, cropped view catches one mourner pressing a hand to her face while another reaches toward her, red and pale drapery filling the frame. The detail comes from a large canvas depicting grief at the Virgin's deathbed.
items.tags: detail view, mourning, drapery, religious art, caravaggio

items.title: The Incredulity of Saint Thomas
items.description_narrative: Caravaggio painted The Incredulity of Saint Thomas in the early 1600s, showing the apostle Thomas pressing a finger into the wound in Christ's side as two other apostles lean in close. The painting belongs to the Sanssouci Picture Gallery.
items.tags: baroque, caravaggio, religious art, chiaroscuro, oil painting, doubting thomas
items.credit_line: Sanssouci Picture Gallery GK I 5438; Wikidata Q2419166 (Google Art Project)

items.title: Sick Bacchus
items.description_narrative: A young man crowned with ivy leaves turns to look over his bare shoulder, holding out a small cluster of grapes, but his skin has a sallow, greenish cast and his lips look pale rather than flushed with wine. Caravaggio painted this as a self-portrait in the guise of Bacchus.
items.tags: bacchus, self-portrait, mythological painting, baroque, caravaggio, chiaroscuro, italian

items.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Matthew
items.description_narrative: Caravaggio painted The Martyrdom of Saint Matthew in 1600, a dramatic multi-figure scene in which an assailant seizes the fallen apostle Matthew as an angel descends from the clouds above. The canvas remains in the church of San Luigi dei Francesi.
items.tags: baroque, caravaggio, religious art, martyrdom, chiaroscuro, oil painting
items.credit_line: Wikidata Q2338417 (Google Art Project full composition)

items.title: The Inspiration of Saint Matthew
items.description_narrative: An angel swoops down from above, robes billowing, reaching toward a bald, bearded old man crowned with a faint halo who looks up in startled attention. The close, cropped framing pushes both figures right to the picture's edge.
items.tags: angel, religious art, tenebrism, caravaggio

items.title: Ecce Homo
items.description_narrative: Christ stands with wrists bound and a crown of thorns pressed into his hair, presented by a man who lifts a cloth from his shoulders. An old, bearded onlooker watches from the shadows with a suspicious, sidelong glance.
items.tags: passion of christ, crown of thorns, tenebrism, caravaggio
items.credit_line: ugH0uYgOidL0bA at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Saint John the Baptist in the Wilderness
items.description_narrative: A young man in a red cloak and animal-skin wrap leans on a reed staff, his gaze lowered in thought against a dark tangle of oak leaves. This is Saint John the Baptist, held today at the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art.
items.tags: saint john the baptist, wilderness, red cloak, chiaroscuro, italian baroque, oak leaves
items.credit_line: qgFz_54y0Kfktw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Musicians
items.description_narrative: Four young men gather closely, one tuning a lute, another holding a sheet of music, a third glancing back toward a fourth partly hidden in shadow, with grapes spilling from a basket at lower left. Caravaggio painted this group around 1595, reportedly including his own likeness among the figures.
items.tags: music, group portrait, allegory, baroque, caravaggio, lute
items.credit_line: This file was donated to Wikimedia Commons as part of a project by the Metropolitan Museum of Art. See the Image and Data Resources Open Access Policy

items.title: Medusa
items.description_narrative: A severed head fills a round, shield-shaped canvas, its mouth open in a scream and its hair a tangle of snakes, blood streaking from the neck. Caravaggio painted this work around 1597.
items.tags: medusa, mythology, gorgon, shield, baroque, caravaggio
items.credit_line: Die Erste Medusa / La première Medusa, ed. 5 Continent

items.title: The Education of the Virgin
items.description_narrative: A seated woman guides a young girl's hand across the pages of an open book, an older man looking on from behind while two cherubs scatter roses from the sky above. A trellis of pink blooms and a stone balustrade frame the quiet lesson.
items.tags: religious art, mary, saint anne, cherubs, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Saint Teresa of Ávila Interceding for Bernardino de Mendoza
items.description_narrative: Peter Paul Rubens painted this vision of Saint Teresa of Ávila in the 1630s, now in the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp. A radiant man wrapped in a flowing red cloth reaches toward a kneeling woman in white and brown robes, while anguished figures reach upward from flames below and winged infants hover above.
items.tags: rubens, flemish baroque, religious art, saint teresa, oil painting, purgatory, counter-reformation, antwerp
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Holy Family with a Parrot
items.description_narrative: A nude child leans into his mother's side as a dark, hook-billed parrot perches on a stone ledge beside them, an elderly man watching quietly from behind. A hazy landscape opens to the left, glimpsed past a leafy vine.
items.tags: holy family, parrot, domestic scene, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Holy Trinity (Throne of Grace)
items.description_narrative: God the Father lifts a white shroud to reveal the body of Christ across his lap as a dove hovers above; two winged children flank them, one holding a spear, reed, and crown of thorns on a staff. Painted in oil paint on panel around 1620, the religious composition hangs in the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: religious art, holy trinity, rubens, baroque, oil on panel, angels, passion instruments
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Incredulity of Saint Thomas
items.description_narrative: Christ extends his hand, palm marked with a visible wound, toward three apostles who lean in close to study it, one reaching out to touch. His red robe slips from bare shoulders as he meets their doubt calmly.
items.tags: doubting thomas, religious art, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Lamentation of Christ (Christ on the Straw)
items.description_narrative: Christ's body rests on a bed of loose straw, his head tipped back and his skin marked with wounds, as one mourner lifts a cloth from his shoulder and others weep behind him. The straw beneath him gives the scene its unusually bare, grounded staging.
items.tags: lamentation, religious art, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Arch of the Mint, Front Face
items.description_narrative: Loose, sketch-like brushwork traces a triumphal arch crowded with allegorical figures, lion sculptures, and coats of arms, the bare panel visible beneath much of the scene. Rubens designed this front face around 1635 as part of the Pompa Introitus Ferdinandi; the sketch belongs to the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: triumphal arch, oil sketch, rubens, allegory, pompa introitus ferdinandi
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Arch of the Mint, Rear Face
items.description_narrative: A companion sketch shows the arch's rear face, capped by a slender tree flanked by two parrots, with a seated bearded figure set into a niche below. Rubens made this study around 1635; like its counterpart, it belongs to the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: triumphal arch, oil sketch, rubens, parrots, pompa introitus ferdinandi
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Heads of Two Apostles
items.description_narrative: Two elderly, bearded heads are pressed close together in profile, one gesturing with a raised finger as if making a point mid-conversation. The tight framing and loose brushwork mark it as a study rather than a finished composition.
items.tags: portrait study, oil sketch, elderly men, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: The Baptism of Christ
items.description_narrative: Christ stands knee-deep in the river beside John the Baptist, cloaked in animal skins, as a white dove descends through a shaft of light and angels gather at the water's edge. Rubens painted this Baptism around 1604–1605; it belongs to the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: baptism of christ, john the baptist, dove, rubens, religious art
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Venus Frigida
items.description_narrative: A goat-legged satyr offers a basket of fruit to a shivering Venus, illustrating the old saying that without Ceres and Bacchus, love itself grows cold. A cupid crouches at her feet wrapped in white cloth, hills opening into a pale sky behind them.
items.tags: venus, satyr, cupid, mythology, allegory, oil painting, flemish baroque
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Minerva Victorious over Ignorance
items.description_narrative: A helmeted woman in armor plants a long spear downward, pinning a fallen nude figure beneath her, drapery and cloud swirling around them both in loose, rapid brushwork. Rubens painted Minerva's triumph in the 1630s.
items.tags: minerva, allegory, mythology, oil sketch, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Kitchen Maid, Butcher and Boy at a Table
items.description_narrative: In broad, loose strokes, a woman offers something from a tray toward a running child while a gesturing man approaches from the right, the whole scene sketched on bare wood with barely any color. It reads more like a rehearsal for a finished picture than a completed one.
items.tags: genre scene, oil sketch, underdrawing, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Bellona
items.description_narrative: Loose sepia brushwork traces a helmeted figure at the center of a churning mass of bodies, weapons, and trophies, the bare wood panel visible through the thin paint. Rubens sketched this Bellona in 1616; it belongs to the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: bellona, oil sketch, rubens, mythology, war allegory
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Adoration of the Magi
items.description_narrative: Kneeling figures press close around the infant in a vast timber stable, their robes pooling on straw while camels crane their necks through the rafters above. Rubens painted this altarpiece in 1624 for the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: adoration of the magi, nativity, camels, rubens, flemish baroque
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Stigmatization of Saint Francis of Assisi
items.description_narrative: A kneeling friar looks up as a winged, crucified figure descends toward him on beams of light, a skull resting on an open book at his feet and a startled companion recoiling below. Rubens paints the whole vision as if it were breaking through storm clouds over a real landscape.
items.tags: saint francis, stigmata, mysticism, religious art, flemish baroque, rubens, vision

items.title: Calvary
items.description_narrative: Three figures hang crucified against a darkening sky, mourners gathered beneath the central cross while an armored soldier reaches up with a sponge on a rod. Rubens painted this Calvary; it belongs to the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: calvary, crucifixion, rubens, religious art, soldiers
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Jupiter and Callisto
items.description_narrative: A cloaked figure gently cups the chin of a nude, reclining woman, an eagle perched watchfully in the wooded shadows behind them. The cloaked figure represents Jupiter in disguise, embracing the nymph Callisto.
items.tags: mythology, nude figure, eagle, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Web Gallery of Art: Image Info about artworkwga QS:P11807,"r/rubens/21mythol/13mythol"

items.title: The Deer Hunt
items.description_narrative: Hounds converge on a fallen deer at the center of a loosely brushed woodland scene, a hunter dashing in from the right as more dogs give chase. Trees and a hazy, distant town fill the rest of the small panel.
items.tags: deer hunt, hounds, landscape, oil sketch, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Hercules and Minerva Expelling Mars
items.description_narrative: Faint brown washes trace a chaotic tangle of struggling, mostly nude figures and a rearing horse, barely emerging from the bare wood panel beneath. The loose, unfinished state captures the composition being worked out before any final painting began.
items.tags: allegory, mythology, oil sketch, underdrawing, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Christ Expiring on the Cross
items.description_narrative: A solitary figure hangs on the cross against a stormy sky, a trilingual inscription pinned above his head and a distant city silhouetted far below. Rubens painted this Christ Expiring on the Cross; it belongs to the Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp.
items.tags: crucifixion, christ, rubens, religious art, stormy sky
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Lamentation over the Dead Christ
items.description_narrative: Outdoors beneath dark rocks and a stormy sky, several mourners kneel around Christ, his pale body laid across their laps, one pressing a hand to his brow. A bucket, a plate of food, and a broom sit abandoned at the edge of the scene, ordinary objects left mid-task.
items.tags: lamentation, outdoor setting, religious art, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: The Triumphal Car of Kallo
items.description_narrative: Sketched loosely on bare wood panel, an ornate chariot heaped with allegorical figures and military trophies is drawn along by unseen power, flags and armor piled above the wheels. The visible pencil lines and unfinished architectural sketches around the edges show this as a working design rather than a finished picture.
items.tags: triumphal car, allegory, pageant design, flemish baroque, rubens, oil sketch, unfinished
items.credit_line: Web Gallery of Art: Image Info about artworkwga QS:P11807,"/r/rubens/7graphic/16sketch"

items.title: Landscape with a Herd of Cows
items.description_narrative: A farmer steadies a bowl while a kneeling woman feeds a calf, and another woman milks a cow beside her, the small herd gathered at the edge of a dense, shadowed wood. A wide pond reflects the stormy sky beyond the treeline.
items.tags: landscape, cattle, farm scene, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Old Woman and Boy with Candles
items.description_narrative: A boy lights a taper from an old woman's candle, their two faces glowing close together against near-total darkness, every wrinkle and strand of hair picked out by the small flame. Rubens painted this candlelit scene in 1616.
items.tags: candlelight, nocturne, portrait, chiaroscuro, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Bathsheba at the Fountain
items.description_narrative: Seated at a marble fountain, a woman lets an attendant comb her hair while a second servant looks on behind her, a small dog barking at her feet. Rubens painted this Bathsheba around 1635; it hangs in the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister in Dresden.
items.tags: bathsheba, rubens, fountain, biblical narrative, baroque

items.title: Pan and Syrinx
items.agent_name: Jan Brueghel and Peter Paul Rubens
items.description_narrative: This mythological scene, painted around 1625 in oil on oak panel, is attributed to Jan Brueghel the Younger and Peter Paul Rubens and held by the Staatliches Museum Schwerin. It shows a woman fleeing through tall reeds from a goat-legged pursuer, with herons and other birds along a riverbank landscape.
items.tags: mythology, pan and syrinx, flemish baroque, landscape, herons, oak panel
items.credit_line: Google Art Project works from the Staatliches Museum Schwerin

items.title: The Flagellation of Christ
items.description_narrative: Christ is bound to a column, his back marked with fresh red welts, as men on either side raise bundles of switches to strike again. The tight, close framing crowds the violence right up to the picture's edge.
items.tags: passion of christ, tenebrism, oil sketch, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Quos Ego: Neptune Calming the Tempest
items.description_narrative: Neptune rises bare-chested from stormy water, a red cloak whipping behind him as he raises a hand to calm the waves. Sea nymphs cluster below him and a rearing horse breaks the surface at right, while distant ships ride out the fading storm; the work is recorded as a copy after Peter Paul Rubens.
items.tags: neptune, mythology, tempest, sea nymphs, seahorse, baroque copy, allegory
items.credit_line: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp
items.current_repository: Royal Museum of Fine Arts Antwerp

items.title: Venus, Mars and Cupid
items.description_narrative: Venus sits half-undressed as Cupid reaches toward her lap and an armored man looks on beside a round mirror propped at their feet. A blaze of red drapery is the only bright color in an otherwise dim interior.
items.tags: venus, mars, cupid, mythology, armor, oil painting, flemish baroque
items.credit_line: sgEGV_FEf7BMWQ at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Venus and Cupid
items.description_narrative: Venus glances sideways as her winged son tilts a mirror for her, one shoulder freed from its wrap. Rubens's warm brushwork softens flesh and drapery alike, set against a shadowed curtain that keeps all the attention on mother and child.
items.tags: venus, cupid, mirror, mythology, nude, oil painting, flemish baroque

items.title: Milkmaids with Cattle in a Landscape, 'The Farm at Laken'
items.description_narrative: Cattle graze and are milked beneath a wide, cloud-streaked sky, while two women fill jugs at the roadside and a cart piled with vegetables waits nearby. Rubens set this pastoral scene at Laeken around 1618, filling it with birds in flight and a distant farmhouse.
items.tags: pastoral, cattle, milkmaid, landscape, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: 9AFIa58vJMeU9Q at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Agrippina and Germanicus
items.description_narrative: Two profile busts overlap almost exactly, the woman's pearl-strung diadem catching the only light in an otherwise dark background. Rubens painted this double portrait in 1614; it hangs in the National Gallery of Art.
items.tags: double portrait, agrippina, germanicus, rubens, roman history
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington D.C.

items.title: Decius Mus Addressing the Legions
items.description_narrative: A general in ornate armor stands on a stone pedestal, one arm raised as he addresses a cluster of soldiers holding standards and spears, an eagle perched watchfully beside him. Discarded armor and a shield lie at the base of the platform.
items.tags: history painting, roman general, oratory, flemish baroque, rubens
items.credit_line: National Gallery of Art, Washington D.C.

items.title: Ceres and Two Nymphs with a Cornucopia
items.description_narrative: Two nude women sit close together as one drapes fruit into an overflowing cornucopia held above them, a third figure looking on and baskets of fruit spilling at their feet. Rubens painted this Ceres around 1617; it hangs in the Dulwich Picture Gallery.
items.tags: ceres, cornucopia, mythology, rubens, abundance
items.credit_line: GwES4aRw3UeNqg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Mars, Venus and Cupid
items.description_narrative: An armored man rests a gauntleted hand on a large shield, leaning close to a fair-haired nude woman as a small child clings at her side. Rubens painted the trio in 1636, pairing Mars's steel with Venus's bare skin.
items.tags: mythology, mars, venus, cupid, allegory, flemish baroque

items.title: Girl with a Fan (Lady in White)
items.description_narrative: A woman in a silvery, gold-embroidered gown holds a small banner-topped staff, a pearl necklace resting against her bare shoulders. The composition is a version after a portrait type by Titian.
items.tags: portrait, silk gown, pearls, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Abundance (Abundantia)
items.description_narrative: A crowned woman in red tips a great cornucopia of fruit as two children gather what spills to the ground, a sun with a human face glowing behind storm clouds above. Rubens painted this allegory of Abundance around 1630; it hangs in the National Museum of Western Art.
items.tags: allegory, abundance, cornucopia, rubens, baroque

items.title: The Calydonian Boar Hunt
items.description_narrative: Riders on rearing horses and hunters with raised spears close in on a massive boar, hounds locked onto its flanks while others already lie fallen on the ground. Rubens painted this scene in the 1610s; it belongs to the J. Paul Getty Museum.
items.tags: boar hunt, mythology, rubens, horses, hounds
items.credit_line: XwEI7aAM8yT8tw at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: Landscape with a Rainbow
items.description_narrative: A wide rainbow arcs over a village of red-roofed houses and a stone bridge, sheep and cattle grazing in the fields below. In the foreground a couple sits close together, a dog and a shepherd nearby, while others gesture toward the sky.
items.tags: landscape, rainbow, pastoral, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: The Wild Boar Hunt
items.description_narrative: Hounds swarm a cornered boar as two hunters drive spears into its flank, while a mounted rider and finely dressed onlookers watch from horseback. Rubens fills the canvas with straining muscle and motion.
items.tags: boar hunt, hounds, hunters, animals, action, oil painting, flemish baroque

items.title: The Adoration of the Magi (Lyon)
items.description_narrative: An elderly king bends low to kiss the infant's foot while a turbaned attendant in gold looks on, the crowd pressed into a dim stable lit mainly by the mother's white gown. Rubens painted this version around 1617–1618; it is held by the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Lyon.
items.tags: adoration of the magi, nativity, kneeling king, rubens, flemish baroque

items.title: Helena Fourment in Her Wedding Dress
items.description_narrative: A young woman in a shimmering gold-patterned gown sits with one gloved hand resting easily at her waist, a heavy red curtain draped behind her and a balustrade opening onto a distant sky. A small wreath of white flowers rests in her upswept hair.
items.tags: portrait, wedding dress, silk gown, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: The Reconciliation of the Romans and the Sabines
items.description_narrative: Sabine women rush between armed ranks of soldiers, pleading with raised arms to halt a clash of spears. A white horse rears at the crowd's edge, and a small child clings to a woman's skirts amid the standoff; the sketch is kept today at the Rubenshuis.
items.tags: history painting, sabine women, soldiers, peace, flemish baroque, oil sketch

items.title: Old Woman with a Basket of Coal
items.description_narrative: A basket of glowing coals throws warm light across three faces gathered close in the dark: a young man, a wide-eyed child, and a smiling old woman holding it steady. The rest of the room disappears into shadow, all attention on that small point of fire.
items.tags: candlelight, genre scene, old woman, flemish baroque, chiaroscuro, night scene, oil on panel

items.title: Adam and Eve (after Titian)
items.description_narrative: A bearded man raises one hand in gesture toward a woman standing beside a tree, both nude but for a few leaves, a small rabbit resting at their feet and a forest receding behind them. The painting depicts Adam and Eve; it is by Peter Paul Rubens and is held in the Rubenshuis.
items.tags: adam and eve, rubens, religious art, nude figures, forest scene

items.title: Christ Triumphant over Death and Sin
items.description_narrative: Christ in flowing red drapery raises a sword in one hand and rests a foot atop a skull, a globe and several cherubs surrounding him in the clouds. Rubens painted this scene around 1618; it hangs in the Musée des Beaux-Arts de Strasbourg.
items.tags: christ triumphant, skull, globe, cherubs, rubens

items.title: Pan and Syrinx
items.agent_name: Peter Paul Rubens and Jan Brueghel the Elder
items.description_narrative: Peter Paul Rubens and Jan Brueghel the Elder painted this close-up version of Pan and Syrinx in 1617, depicting the nymph pulling free of her robe as Pan grasps at the reeds where she vanishes. Ducks swim nearby in a pool fringed with water lilies and yellow iris, in a panel held by the Gemäldegalerie Alte Meister.
items.tags: mythology, flemish baroque, oil painting, pan, rubens, collaboration

items.title: Worship of Venus
items.description_narrative: Peter Paul Rubens painted this mythological tribute to Venus in the 1630s; it belongs to the Nationalmuseum. A statue of Venus stands on a pedestal at right as women approach with an offering, while dozens of winged infants play among fruit and cloth on the grass below and more fly through the trees above.
items.tags: rubens, mythological painting, venus, flemish baroque, oil painting, putti, allegory, nationalmuseum
items.credit_line: IAHuqzg-yAhLtg at Google Cultural Institute maximum zoom level

items.title: The Death of Decius Mus
items.description_narrative: Rearing horses and clashing soldiers crowd a storm-lit battlefield, fallen bodies heaped in the foreground beneath a pale, winged figure descending through the smoke overhead. Rubens painted this Death of Decius Mus in the 1610s; it is held by the Liechtenstein Museum.
items.tags: death of decius mus, battle scene, rubens, roman history, horses

items.title: The Voyage of the Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand: Neptune Calming the Tempest
items.description_narrative: Neptune strides through churning surf with his trident raised, rearing sea-horses and clinging nereids around him, while tall-masted ships ride out a storm under a heavy sky behind him.
items.tags: neptune, sea, storm, mythology, ships, oil sketch, flemish baroque

items.title: Landscape with Cows and Duck Hunters
items.description_narrative: A hunter crouches by the water's edge, gun raised and a dog waiting at his side, while cattle graze and women milk cows on the opposite side of the clearing. Tall trees frame both the hunt and the farmyard in a single unbroken landscape.
items.tags: landscape, hunting, cattle, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Landscape with a Gallows
items.description_narrative: A hanged figure sways from a gallows on the left, barely visible against dark storm clouds, while a fortified tower and clustered rooftops rise in the hazy distance. A bird's nest perches on a bent pole nearby, an odd note of ordinary life beside the scene of execution.
items.tags: landscape, gallows, storm clouds, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Fortuna
items.description_narrative: A nude woman balances lightly on a rolling sphere, one arm raised to catch a length of pale cloth billowing overhead like a sail. The loose, translucent brushwork gives the whole figure a sense of continuous motion.
items.tags: allegory, fortune, nude figure, oil sketch, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Landscape with the Shipwreck of Saint Paul
items.description_narrative: Storm-dark clouds part into a pale rainbow over a rugged, tree-covered coastline, with small figures scattered along the distant shore. Rubens painted this turbulent scene around 1625; a man traditionally identified as Paul the Apostle is worked into the landscape's drama.
items.tags: landscape, storm, rainbow, seascape, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: The Raising of Lazarus
items.description_narrative: Christ reaches out with an open hand toward a shrouded man being lifted upright by two companions, still wrapped in burial cloth. Onlookers press close, their faces caught between grief and astonishment, in a canvas that hangs today in Berlin's Gemaldegalerie.
items.tags: religious, miracle, lazarus, christ, biblical, flemish baroque, resurrection

items.title: Saint Cecilia
items.description_narrative: Saint Cecilia looks up in rapture beside a keyboard instrument, surrounded by cherubs reaching toward her from a table and the floor. She wears rich green and gold silks, with a glimpse of columns behind her in a grand interior.
items.tags: saint cecilia, music, cherubs, religious, flemish baroque, interior

items.title: The Drunken Silenus
items.description_narrative: A heavyset, bearded old man leans on those around him, grapevines draped over his shoulder, as children gather spilled grapes and melons at his feet. Bare-chested figures raise tambourines nearby in a scene of boisterous celebration.
items.tags: bacchanal, revelry, mythology, flemish baroque

items.title: The Penitent Magdalene
items.description_narrative: Mary Magdalene turns her face to the sky in a wooded clearing, a skull and a coiled snake resting near her feet. Two putti play in the grass beside her, and an angel and a boy look on from a stone ledge; the painting today hangs in Berlin's Gemaldegalerie.
items.tags: mary magdalene, religious, landscape, putti, angel, flemish baroque, penitence

items.title: Madonna and Child
items.description_narrative: A standing infant leans into his mother's chest as she looks down at him, one hand resting on an illuminated book open on a red-draped table, with roses at left and a basket of grapes and peaches at right. Rubens painted the figures, and Jan Brueghel the Younger the flowers and fruit, sometime in the 17th century.
items.tags: madonna and child, religious, flowers, still life, flemish baroque, collaboration

items.title: Three Riders in Different Positions
items.description_narrative: Three plumed horsemen appear side by side in different poses, one horse rearing sharply while the others walk and trot, painted almost entirely in gray and cream tones. Rubens uses the same rider three times over to study how a mounted figure holds himself at each gait.
items.tags: equestrian, oil sketch, horses, flemish baroque, rubens, study, grisaille

items.title: Atalanta and Meleager
items.description_narrative: A woman rests a hand on the head of a slain wild boar as a bare-chested man beside her looks on and another figure sounds a hunting horn, a dog crouched at their feet. Painted in oil on wood panel around 1616, this mythological scene by Peter Paul Rubens depicts Atalanta and Meleager and is held at the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
items.tags: mythology, atalanta, meleager, rubens, hunting scene, oil on panel, baroque

items.title: The Andrians
items.description_narrative: Peter Paul Rubens painted this mythological revel in the 1630s, now in the Nationalmuseum. Figures drink and embrace beneath tall trees near the shore, a nude woman reclines in the foreground with flowers in hand, and a small child stands among the revelers.
items.tags: rubens, mythological painting, bacchanal, flemish baroque, oil painting, nude figures, revelers, landscape

items.title: The Feast of Herod
items.description_narrative: A woman in a sweeping red gown presents a severed head on a platter to a startled man seated at a banquet table, other guests recoiling or looking away. In the foreground, a child plays with a small monkey, oblivious to the horror behind them.
items.tags: banquet, salome, religious drama, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Evening Landscape with a Timber Wagon
items.description_narrative: Dense, shadowed trees crowd around a still pond as evening light fades from the sky, a small figure leading a horse-drawn timber wagon along the water's edge. Birds cut across the pale sky above the canopy.
items.tags: landscape, evening light, timber wagon, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Lot and His Daughters
items.description_narrative: Beneath a sweeping curtain of red drapery, a bearded, reclining man is offered wine and food by two women — one in blue silk pouring from a jug, the other nude and presenting a platter of fruit. Rubens painted the group around 1613–1614 with characteristically warm, fleshy modeling.
items.tags: figures, reclining nude, drapery, biblical, flemish baroque, rubens

items.title: Las Meninas
items.description_narrative: A young girl in a pale gown stands at the center of a dim, high-ceilinged room, flanked by kneeling attendants and a large dog at her feet. At left, a painter stands before an enormous canvas, brush raised; a small mirror on the back wall holds two faint reflected figures. Velázquez completed this royal group portrait in 1656.
items.tags: royal portrait, spanish baroque, velazquez, mirror, court, group portrait
